homeRoomRoles._about: A pattern may name a room by role (e.g. study_room, bedroom). Each structured pattern maps every role it uses to a real room id of the persona's house type.

away: any place other than home (including being on the way)

personActions._about: Everything the person can do. 'do' is the action name used in structured patterns. Phone actions are refused while asleep or driving; hand actions at home need the person in that room.

home.command.note: physical = at the device (person must be in that room); mobile_app = from the phone, anywhere

home.record.note: hand-made states: window_contact / door_contact open or closed (person must be in that room)

person.travel.note: takes time; leaving and arriving home also logs the front door, lock and occupancy

args.next: {package: weight} for each following app (optional, default = first; never the same app twice in a row)
args.continue: chance to switch to another app after each app (0-1; 0.32 gives 1 app 68%, 2 apps 22%, 3 apps 7%, as in Bohmer et al. 2011)
args.seconds: {"default": {"median": s, "sigma": x}, package: {...}}: time on each app, lognormal
args.maxApps: optional cap on apps in one use (default 15)

phone.useApps.note: one ordinary use of the phone: the screen comes on, the apps follow one another, the screen goes off by hand or by time-out (phoneHabits). Use this for everyday phone use instead of openApp / wait / closeApp.

phone.setActivity.note: not while travelling; trips set activity themselves

phone.appNotice.note: a notification the person's OWN action makes an app show (navigation running, timer running, reminder set). Use with phone.openApp to stand in for in-app actions the phone schema has no type for (navigation, checklist, timer).

extraApps._about: Apps only some personas have. A persona has one when its profile uses it (installed from the start, no install line). uid and mbPerMin are fixed so the same app looks the same for every persona; mbPerMin values are estimates.

phoneSignals._about: Things happening TO the phone that conditions or triggers may watch (generated by the environment or other people, not by the person).
phoneSignals.NOTIFICATION: incoming message or app notification (package, title, text)
phoneSignals.CALENDAR REMINDER: an event starts (at its start time)
phoneSignals.HEALTH HOURLY: hourly steps / distance / kcal / heart rate

houseTypes._deviceIds: A house has device '<room>.<deviceType>' for every deviceType whose rooms include a room of that house type (e.g. 3room has room1.lamp, kitchen.oven; 2room has no room3).
